name_en: system-landing methodology/gather the entire institutional project into one circulating title of the monarch ('the Lawgiver,' Kanuni): codes, the circle of justice, the mosques and the poems together verify 'this man is the institution'—institutional and personal authority pledged to each other, the title the confluence of the empire's self-narrative and the outside world's (the Europeans' 'the Magnificent')
category: 体系落地方法论/把全部制度工程收束于君主的一个可传播头衔（'立法者'Kanuni）：法典、正义之环、清真寺、诗篇共同验证'此人即制度'——制度权威与人格权威互相质押，头衔成为帝国自我叙事与外部叙事（欧洲人的 the Magnificent）的汇合点
modes.domain_zh: 苏莱曼全部制度工程与其形象经营合观所呈现的方法。他继承的帝国有一切要素：法典、税册、海军、waqf、宫廷文化——但要素不等于叙事。他的收束设计是把全部制度工程指向一个单一头衔：Kanuni（立法者）。这个头衔的工艺特性有三。其一，'多源汇聚'：法典工程（kanunname）、正义实践（'正义之环'的政治哲学——苏丹作为牧人保护圈内的秩序，重臣以生命质押法律）、文化供养（清真寺的穹顶即'正义之环'的空间化）、亲笔诗篇（Muhibbi 的道德抒情）——四条线索在同一头衔汇流，'立法者'不是自我册封而是全部制度的结晶；同时外部世界以 the Magnificent（壮丽者）应和——内外叙事在同一个人格上交换背书。其二，'人格质押制度'：苏丹以处死逾法的易卜拉欣、亲自主持税册审议、亲征至七十岁，把'制度高于任何人（除我）'示范到极致——人格为制度作保，制度也因人格而不可被官僚层架空。其三，'头衔的可传播性'：Kanuni 不是一个战役名而是一个身份词，可在教法讨论、民间故事（他被记为公正法官的民间叙事）、外交文书中无限复用——头衔即叙事的最小可传播单元。代价与极限：人格收束把制度命运与一人寿命捆绑——塞利姆二世以后'立法者'后继无人，制度失去人格的质押后迅速官僚化与腐化；内外双叙事在国力转折点分裂（欧洲人此后只记得 the Magnificent 的华彩而忘记 Kanuni 的法度）；且头衔的完美本身成为攻击面——其子穆斯塔法的处死（因许蕾姆与鲁斯坦的宫廷斗争）在民间叙事中永久性地刺破了'公正立法者'的圣像。
modes.domain_en: The method presented by reading all of Suleiman's institutional works together with his image-making. He inherited an empire possessing every element—codes, registers, a navy, waqfs, court culture—but elements are not narrative. His closure-design pointed every institutional project at a single title: Kanuni, the Lawgiver. Three craft properties. First, many-source confluence: the codification (kanunnames), the practice of justice (the political philosophy of the 'circle of justice'—the sultan as shepherd guarding order within the ring, grandees pledging life for the law), cultural patronage (the mosque domes as spatialized circle of justice), and his own verses (Muhibbi's moral lyric)—four streams converging on one title, 'Lawgiver' not self-conferred but crystallized out of all the institutions; while the outside world answered with 'the Magnificent'—inner and outer narratives exchanging endorsements on a single person. Second, the person pledges the institutions: by executing the law-breaking Ibrahim, personally reviewing the registers, campaigning to seventy, the sultan demonstrated 'the institution stands above everyone but me' at the extreme—the person guarantees the institutions, and the institutions thereby cannot be hollowed out by the bureaucracy. Third, the title's transmissibility: Kanuni is not a battle-name but an identity-word, endlessly reusable in jurisprudence, folk tales (he is remembered in popular narrative as the just judge) and diplomatic documents—the title as the minimal transmissible unit of narrative. Costs and limits: personal closure binds the institutions' fate to one man's lifespan—after Selim II no heir to 'the Lawgiver' arose, and stripped of the person's pledge the institutions bureaucratized and rotted fast; the double narrative split at the turning of imperial fortunes (Europe thereafter remembered the Magnificent's splendor and forgot Kanuni's law); and the perfection of the title itself became an attack surface—the execution of his son Mustafa (in the court struggle of Hürrem and Rüstem) permanently pierced the icon of 'the just lawgiver' in popular narrative.
modes.definition_zh: 体系落地方法论/收束三件套：多源汇聚（法典、正义实践、文化供养、亲笔诗篇在同一头衔汇流）+ 人格质押制度（以身守法示范'制度高于任何人'）+ 头衔的可传播性（身份词而非战役名，可无限复用）——内外叙事在同一人格上交换背书
modes.definition_en: System-landing methodology/a closure triad: many-source confluence (codes, just practice, patronage, one's own poems converging on one title) + the person pledging the institutions (obeying one's own law unto kinsmen, 'the institution above all but me') + the title's transmissibility (an identity-word, not a battle-name, endlessly reusable)—inner and outer narratives exchanging endorsements on one person
modes.source_chapter: 'Kanuni'称号在史书（佩切维、萨阿德丁）与民间叙事中的成立；'正义之环'（adalet dairesi）的政治哲学文献；易卜拉欣处死（1536）与穆斯塔法处死（1553）的双重司法叙事
key_concepts: 多源汇聚 many-source confluence（全部制度工程结晶于一个头衔）
人格质押 the person's pledge（以身守法使制度不可被官僚架空）
正义之环 the circle of justice（牧人-秩序的政治哲学与穹顶的空间化）
头衔即单元 title-as-unit（叙事的最小可传播单元）
双叙事背书 double-narrative endorsement（内外叙事在同一人格上互证）
modes.key_quote_zh: 让法典、穹顶与诗篇说同一句话——说到底只剩两个字：立法者。头衔比帝国活得久，因为它可以被无限次复述。
modes.key_quote_en: Let the codes, the domes and the poems say one thing—till only two words remain: the Lawgiver. The title outlives the empire, for it can be repeated without end.
process_zh: 盘点制度工程并找汇聚点：列出全部制度产出（法典、正义实践、文化供养、亲笔示范），寻找能被一句话命名的共同指向——收束点必须能涵盖全部而不歪曲任何一条
以身质押制度：领袖公开执行约束自身的规则（处死重臣、公开审议、终身亲征），使'制度高于任何人（除我）'成为可观察事实——人格质押是制度免于官僚架空的唯一担保
把收束点提炼为可传播单元：头衔必须是身份词而非事件名——可在法理、民间、外交语域无限复用的最小叙事单元
管理收束的攻击面：人格完美本身就是攻击面，须预设'圣像刺破'的应对叙事（承认污点而不崩塌），并以制度账户的独立性对冲人格账户的塌陷——收束失效时制度应可独立运转
process_en: Inventory the institutional works and find the confluence: list all institutional outputs (codes, just practice, patronage, personal example) and seek a one-phrase common direction—the closure point must cover all without distorting any

Pledge the institutions with the person: have the leader publicly enforce rules binding himself (executing grandees, open review, campaigning for life), making 'the institution above everyone but me' an observable fact—the person's pledge is the only guarantee against bureaucratic hollowing
Refine the closure point into a transmissible unit: the title must be an identity-word, not an event-name—the minimal narrative unit reusable without limit in legal, folk and diplomatic registers

Manage the closure's attack surface: perfection of the persona is itself an attack surface—pre-script the response to 'icon-piercing' (admit the stain without collapse) and hedge the personal account's fall with the independence of the institutional account—when closure fails, the institutions should still run
representative_cases_zh: 'Kanuni'称号的成立：从 kanunname 到民间'公正法官'叙事再到欧洲人的 the Magnificent——四源汇聚与双叙事背书的完整收束
处死易卜拉欣（1536）：帝国第二人以身殉法——人格质押制度的最高示范，同时是'法随人存'的风险起点
处死穆斯塔法（1553）：储君因宫廷斗争被杀——'公正立法者'圣像的永久刺破，收束法攻击面的历史教训
representative_cases_en: The rise of 'Kanuni': from kanunnames through folk narrative of 'the just judge' to the Europeans' 'the Magnificent'—the complete closure of four-source confluence and double endorsement
The execution of Ibrahim (1536): the empire's second man dying for the law—the highest demonstration of the person's pledge, and the beginning of 'the law lives only while the man lives'
The execution of Mustafa (1553): the heir killed in court struggle—the permanent piercing of the 'just lawgiver' icon, the historical lesson of the closure's attack surface
modern_applications_zh: 创始人IP与公司制度的收束设计：把全部制度创新提炼为一个可传播身份词（而非口号），创始人以公开行为（个人守法、公开复盘）质押制度——同时预设'创始人塌陷'的对冲（制度账户独立审计）
城市与国家的品牌收束：把市政工程、文化活动与治理实践收束于一个可复用身份词，并在治理转折点前预设内外叙事分裂的预案
个人职业的身份收束：把作品、方法论与公开行为收束为一个身份词，使叙事可以在行业、媒体与民间三个语域无限复用——同时管理完美人设的攻击面（承认失败记录）
modern_applications_en: Closing founder-IP and corporate institutions: distill all institutional innovation into one transmissible identity-word (not a slogan), with the founder pledging the institutions through public conduct (personal compliance, open retrospectives)—hedged by an independent institutional account against founder collapse

Brand closure for cities and states: gather civic works, cultural programs and governance practice into one reusable identity-word, with a pre-scripted plan for inner-outer narrative split at governance turning points

Personal identity closure in careers: gather works, methodology and public conduct into one identity-word reusable across industry, media and folk registers—while managing the attack surface of a perfect persona (keep the record of failures)

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——以 Kanuni 头衔完成帝国制度工程的收束，并以其攻击面留下教训
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—closed the empire's institutional project under the title Kanuni, leaving also the lesson of its attack surface

representative_figures.relation_zh: 人格收束的平行立法者——同以人格为体系最后论证，但以生活验证命题而非以人格质押制度
representative_figures.relation_en: the parallel legislator of personal closure—likewise made the person the system's final argument, but by life verifying propositions rather than a person pledging institutions

representative_figures.relation_zh: 头衔收束的对照——'太阳王'收束的是宫廷美学与贵族驯服，苏莱曼收束的是法度与正义——同为一人格收束一帝国，收束物的法度含量不同
representative_figures.relation_en: the contrast in closure—'the Sun King' closed court aesthetics and tamed nobles while Suleiman closed law and justice: one person closing one empire each, differing in the legal weight of what is closed
